name: aws2-ddb
title: AWS DynamoDB
description: Store and retrieve data from AWS DynamoDB.
label: cloud,database

properties.name: tableName
properties.description: The name of the table currently worked with.

properties.name: consistentRead
properties.description: Determines whether strong consistency should be enforced when data is read.

properties.name: enabledInitialDescribeTable
properties.description: Set whether the initial Describe table operation in the DDB Endpoint must be done, or not.

properties.name: keyAttributeName
properties.description: Attribute name when creating table

properties.name: keyAttributeType
properties.description: Attribute type when creating table

properties.name: keyScalarType
properties.description: The key scalar type, it can be S (String), N (Number) and B (Bytes)

properties.name: operation
properties.description: What operation to perform

properties.name: overrideEndpoint
properties.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with uriEndpointOverride option

properties.name: readCapacity
properties.description: The provisioned throughput to reserve for reading resources from your table

properties.name: region
properties.description: The region in which DDB client needs to work

properties.name: uriEndpointOverride
properties.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

properties.name: writeCapacity
properties.description: The provisioned throughput to reserved for writing resources to your table

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: amazonDDBClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use the AmazonDynamoDB as the client

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the DDB client

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: The region in which DynamoDB client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

properties.name: proxyProtocol
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the DDB client

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Access Key

properties.name: profileCredentialsName
properties.label: security
properties.description: If using a profile credentials provider this parameter will set the profile name

properties.name: secretKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Secret Key

properties.name: sessionToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume a IAM role

properties.name: trustAllCertificates
properties.label: security
properties.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

properties.name: useDefaultCredentialsProvider
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider or to expect static credentials to be passed in.

properties.name: useProfileCredentialsProvider
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the DDB client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

properties.name: useSessionCredentials
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the DDB client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in situation in which the user needs to assume a IAM role for doing operations in DDB.
